note: The obituary "Send flowers" fallback: a Florist One affiliate link, used only when the obituary's funeral home has no known florist page (data/funeral-homes.json). affiliateId is empty until Sam joins the program; with no ID the link goes to fallbackUrl instead: Florist One's public funeral-flowers page, no affiliate code, no "paid link" label, rel="noopener nofollow" (checked: it answered 200 on Oct 18, 2026). Set fallbackUrl to "" to hide the link again when there is no florist page and no ID. The server env var FLORIST_ONE_AFFILIATE_ID, when set, wins over affiliateId. affiliateUrl is the link with {id} replaced by the ID. Its shape is the one Florist One's own published affiliate links use (https://www.floristone.com/index.cfm?AffiliateID=<id>&source_id=aff); the signup page doesn't show it before joining.
